findings.desc: Active docs/prompts still advertise koala CLI commands after the lattice-only alias-removal story. Examples: CLAUDE.md:6 says first command is `koala session_brief`, CLAUDE.md:44-63 keeps a `koala` CLI cheatsheet, .Codex/agents/koala-review-docs.md:12-21 and :50-69 tell reviewers to run `koala session_brief`, `koala validate`, and other `koala` commands, .Codex/agents/koala-review-story-init.md:8-10 and :18-27 require `koala init_check_set` / `koala session_brief`, and .claude/agents/koala-review-test-coverage.md:16 and :27-45 use `koala review_run_start`, `koala story_get`, `koala validate`, and `koala finding_add`. These are active guidance/prompt assets, not historical notes, so CHK-001/CHK-002 docs acceptance is not met until the active command examples are migrated to `lattice` or explicitly marked non-active history.

CHK-002:edge:1 has no verificationEvidence entry. The intent asks to prove existing user-owned legacy files are not overwritten; scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs and thin-init-assets-smoke exercise that behavior, and I reran both successfully, but no evidence is bound to CHK-002:edge:1, so TEST coverage has no exact intentRef for this accepted edge case.

Active Claude/Codex reviewer guidance still tells agents to use the removed koala CLI alias. CLAUDE.md:6-15 requires `koala session_brief`, `koala validate`, and story commands; .claude/agents/koala-review-concept.md:12-21 and .Codex/agents/koala-review-concept.md:12-21 mirror the same active instructions; packages/main/templates/agents/koala-review-concept.md:12-21 would regenerate them for new assets. This is not preserved historical/process evidence: these files are live entry/prompt assets, so removing bin/koala.js and package bin aliases while leaving them to run `koala` makes fresh reviewers/Claude users follow an inactive compatibility path.
